- [Full audit, line counts, and critique notes](</C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-7e47969c4c7a654f/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T145733Z/work/audit.md>)

The search uses one broad COVID-19/pandemic and restriction block; lifestyle and well-being outcomes are screened rather than required as a second block. The publication cutoff is **2020-11-22**. PubMed returned **151,652 records** with that cutoff.

All six records in the small development set were retrieved. That is **relative recall on records used while building the strategy**, not independent validation; no held-out set was available. The draft still needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
